adjuster_notes: Supply line connection showed wear consistent with normal aging. No evidence of improper installation or neglect. Damage limited to small flooring section and two cabinet kickboards. Premium policy covers appliance-related water damage with no deductible for claims under $2,500. Approved for hardwood floor section repair and cabinet kickboard replacement.
description: A supply line connection to the dishwasher loosened over time and began leaking water onto the kitchen floor during a wash cycle. The homeowner noticed water pooling around the base of the dishwasher and spreading under adjacent cabinetry. Approximately 3 gallons of water leaked before the supply was shut off. The hardwood flooring in a 4-foot radius showed cupping and discoloration, and the kickboard of two lower cabinets absorbed moisture.
